summary: Tested SpeakerManagerPanel global replacement for per-turn pencil editing. All core features verified on meeting 6a3f92df95f60e56302d0d5e (3 speakers: Test Manager 59 turns, Worker 55 turns, Speaker 1 turn). Swap All button not tested (requires 2-speaker meeting; no such meeting with speaker_text found).

test_results.PASS - 3 unique speakers listed with ren: speaker-rename-Test-Manager, speaker-rename-Worker, speaker-rename-Speaker with correct turn counts (59, 55, 1)
test_results.PASS - Bulk rename updates all turns liv: Renaming 'Test Manager' to 'Supervisor Smith' updated all 59 pills instantly
test_results.PASS - Save/Discard appear only after ch: Both hidden initially, both visible after rename
test_results.PASS - Discard resets all labels: pill-0 reset to 'Test Manager', rename input reset, Save/Discard hidden again
test_results.PASS - Save persists to DB: Renamed 'Worker' to 'Employee', saved; 55 pills show 'Employee'; Save/Discard hidden after
test_results.PASS - Full Text / Speaker View toggle w: Panel hidden in Full Text, visible in Speaker View
test_results.PASS - No per-turn pencil editing: speaker-pill-0 is a span, not a button
test_results.PASS - Swap button hidden with 3 speaker: swap-speakers-btn not present when 3 unique speakers
test_results.SKIPPED - Swap All button test: No meeting with exactly 2 unique speakers in speaker_text found; code logic reviewed and correct (canSwap = uniqueSpeakers.length === 2)

action_items: Note: Test data was modified during testing (Worker -> Employee saved, then restored to Worker). DB state for meeting 6a3f92df95f60e56302d0d5e should have original speakers.
Minor: Swap All button could not be end-to-end tested via UI as no seed meeting with exactly 2 speakers is available. Code logic is correct but UI test not performed.
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean and well-structured. SpeakerManagerPanel correctly uses originalTurns for speaker counts ensuring Swap only shows with 2 original speakers.
handleSwap properly guards with keys.length !== 2 check.
handleSave correctly serializes renamed turns and calls PATCH endpoint.
speakerMap resets via useEffect on speaker_text change after save.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (9/10 features verified, Swap UI not tested)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily renamed Worker->Employee and back to Worker during testing
